summary: preinstall beacon leaks installer IP to third-party host
details: xapi-lib@88.2.3 declares `preinstall: node index.js` in package.json, and index.js performs an unconditional top-level HTTPS GET to realwbx.com/ip.php (passing `8.8.8.8` and a hardcoded Authorization header) on load. The call fires automatically during `npm install`, sending the installer's source IP to a hardcoded non-publisher endpoint unrelated to any advertised functionality. The package itself is a one-file stub with no library content, so dependency resolution plus the preinstall beacon is the entire effect of installing it. The destination realwbx.com is not a publisher-aligned domain, the request is not caller-configurable, and no documentation discloses the outbound call.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
